description: What has happened to this business, and when? Returns dated events, newest first: formed, location opened or closed, licensed, license surrendered or expired, location transferred between entities, license applied for. Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. Each event names its source record. Example: {"entity_id": "32057926266", "include_affiliates": true}.

entity_id.description: entity_id from resolve_business (11-digit Texas taxpayer number), or a 10-digit SOS file number.

include_affiliates.description: Also include affiliated entities (likely common control, confidence >= 0.5). Default false.

since.description: Only events on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_timeline
title: History of a Texas business
